title: Request portfolio curation and sprint-fit scaffold
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Create a repeatable, lightweight process and artifact set for Sales/CS to aggregate enterprise feature requests, perform an initial scoping pass, and produce a prioritized request portfolio that is sprint-fit. The scaffold should: 1) normalize ask metadata (persona, ask type, rough effort), 2) surface econ/impact signals required for prioritization, 3) provide a one-page technical feasibility quick-check for Eng/Infra, and 4) produce a recommended handoff packet for PMs and Solutions Engineers. This ticket scopes the playbook, templates, and a first pilot with two high-touch accounts.
acceptance_criteria: A one-page intake template (Drive/Confluence) that Sales/CS can fill in under 10 minutes
A prioritization rubric (3 axes: customer value, implementation cost, strategic fit) with example thresholds
A triage script for Solutions Engineers to collect feasibility notes and common blockers
Pilot run completed with two accounts and feedback documented
Handoff checklist that results in a PM-summarized brief (<= 2 pages) and a clear next-step (POC, design spike, or backlog)
Dashboard card in Intake tracker that shows request status and estimated sprint-fit readiness
decisions: Use a 3-point effort estimate (Small / Medium / Large) for initial scoping to keep friction low
Prioritization will use weighted scoring: 50% customer value, 30% cost, 20% strategic fit
All enterprise asks must include at least one concrete business metric from Sales/CS (e.g., ARR upsell, churn reduction)
Early feasibility notes from Solutions Engineers are advisory — final technical estimate owned by Eng during grooming
